plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Health-Studies-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 9/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. The map's title block prints only 'Health Studies'; the BA is the degree in the official UW Bothell degree list for this program. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. No parenthetical credit number is printed anywhere on this map, so under the printed rule every slot is 5 credits, each quarter sums to 15 and the plan to 180, the standard UW Bothell bachelor's total. The map's credit-rule line adds: 'BHS core offered in Fall/Winter/Spring. Some BHS core courses are only offered one quarter a year.' Markers are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain, so no prereqs are recorded): the diamond means 'Prerequisite: Must be completed prior to applying for a major'; the checkmark means 'Milestones: Courses and special requirements necessary to timely progress through and complete a major'; the star means 'see list of choices' — those lists are not printed on the map, so star-marked slots list no options; the four-point marker means 'May be fulfilled with Discovery Core'. No (F) fieldwork marker is printed on this map; BHS 496 is titled 'Fieldwork in Health' with no (F) marker. Competitive-applicant guidance printed on the map (prerequisites completed or in progress at application, cumulative GPA 3.0, minimum 3.0 GPA in both required composition courses, personal statement) is disclosed here and not encoded. Per-year printed notes: Year 1 — transferred coursework, elective selection, minor and graduate school prerequisites should be discussed with an advisor; B MATH 215 and one writing course recommended by end of Year 1. Year 2 — apply to the major in Winter Quarter of Year 2 (Spring deadline February 1st); BHS 201 and one writing course recommended by end of Year 2. Year 3 — meet Career Services; apply to graduate in Spring Quarter of Year 3; BHS 210, BHS 300, BHS 302 and BHS 305 recommended by end of Year 3. Year 4 — BHS 403 and BHS 496 recommended by end of Year 4; BHS 496 may be taken any quarter of the final year (its printed pre-requisite is all BHS core completed, co-requisite BHS 403 — disclosed here, not encoded as a prereq, per this series' no-invented-prereq practice for these maps). Generic slots are recorded as choice slots with unique synthetic codes.
